purpose: Identify conditional post-2030 CPU revenue growth required to support the observed quote and a chosen 10% annual target return. This is a reverse hurdle, not a forecast or proof of market expectations.
held_fixed: 2027-2030 selected deliveries, profit, cash and capex
CPU margin phase to YTD residual or pre-existing pooled residual
tax, credit, claims, share and treasury policy
varied: Constant 2031-2040 CPU revenue CAGR; 2041 returns to 3%. No infinite high-growth tail.
capital_rule: Recompute Products, host external sales, physical capex, depreciation and working capital each year; no free growth.
thresholds: Dec2026 planning value equals Nov5 quote52.25; disclose56-day mismatch
Dec2030 target produces10% annual price return over exact holding period
guard: Do not choose an operating case or lower the asset rate merely because the threshold is met. Multiple inputs can explain the same price; inverse analysis does not identify a unique market forecast.
